form.label: Advanced Workshop #1 — Metrics & Traces
form.description: Self-contained capstone: auto-instrumented trace latency and JVM/HikariCP metrics, entirely inside Splunk Enterprise — no external Splunkbase app required.

div.p: Auto-instrumentation (the Java agent, zero code changes) generates traces and JVM metrics that the Collector routes by index — k8s_ws_traces for spans, k8s_ws_petclinic_metrics for JVM/HikariCP — and every panel below is built from that data with plain SPL, no external app required.

search.query: index=k8s_ws_traces | stats count as value | table value
index=k8s_ws_traces | eval ms=(end_time-start_time)/1000000 | stats perc90(ms) as value | eval value=round(value,2) | table value
| mstats avg(jvm.memory.used) as value WHERE index=k8s_ws_petclinic_metrics jvm.memory.type=heap span=10s | sort - _time | head 1 | eval value=round(value/1024/1024,2) | table value

panel.title: Trace Volume & Error Spans Over Time

search.query: index=k8s_ws_traces | rename "status.code" as status_code | eval is_error=if(status_code=="STATUS_CODE_ERROR",1,0) | timechart span=$span_token$ count as "Total Spans" sum(is_error) as "Error Spans"

panel.title: JVM Heap Used Over Time — Auto-Instrumented, No Code Changes (heap vs. non-heap, 10s resolution)
panel.description: Sawtooth pattern is expected: heap usage climbs as objects are allocated, then drops sharply on each garbage-collection cycle.

search.query: | mstats avg(jvm.memory.used) WHERE index=k8s_ws_petclinic_metrics span=10s BY jvm.memory.type | xyseries _time jvm.memory.type avg(jvm.memory.used)

index=k8s_ws_traces | rename "attributes.http.route" as route | where isnotnull(route) | eval ms=(end_time-start_time)/1000000 | stats count, avg(ms) as avg_ms, max(ms) as max_ms by route | eval avg_ms=round(avg_ms,2), max_ms=round(max_ms,2) | sort -avg_ms | rename route as "Route", count as "Span Count", avg_ms as "Avg Latency (ms)", max_ms as "Max Latency (ms)"

panel.title: HikariCP Connection Pool Health (Current)
panel.description: idle + active should sum to at most the pool max; a nonzero pending-requests count means callers are queued waiting for a free connection.

search.query: | mstats latest(db.client.connections.usage) as value WHERE index=k8s_ws_petclinic_metrics BY state | stats latest(value) as value by state | eval metric=if(state="idle","Idle Connections","Active Connections") | eval value=round(value,0) | table metric value | append [ | mstats latest(db.client.connections.max) as value WHERE index=k8s_ws_petclinic_metrics | eval metric="Max Pool Size" | eval value=round(value,0) | table metric value ] | append [ | mstats latest(db.client.connections.pending_requests) as value WHERE index=k8s_ws_petclinic_metrics | eval metric="Pending Requests" | eval value=round(value,0) | table metric value ] | rename metric as "Metric", value as "Value"
